config.scope: Multi-recording-group development pilot, fixed update budget and internal validation selection
config.selection: Groups 03/05 for training and 06 for internal validation fixed by names before event downloads or predictions. Retain regardless of results; all evaluation groups already exposed.
config.selection_rule: Highest full-GT recall at validation-label-selected <=1 FP/query with score floor0.3 among updates116/232/348; ties choose earlier update. Validation thresholds are selection diagnostics, then selected weights get separate Thun calibration. Never use the four evaluation sequences for selection.
config.training: Same inherited input, positive-normalized loss and autograd-preserving fixed-BN fusion. All feature Conv2d + heads versus heads only. BN/neuron states frozen. Global shuffled window pool; identical sample schedule and updates in both trained variants.
limitations: Internal validation has few recording groups
All four evaluation groups have historical exposure
Same updates as prior single-group pilot does not imply same epoch count or training cost
No gate training or formal hypothesis confirmation
